bugs.error_message: Patch verification failed while updating the MODFLOW archive input manifests because one path was specified without the modflow-executables directory and the expected MODFLOW-96 description did not match.
bugs.root_cause: The multi-file patch used an incorrect absolute path and an initially mismatched description string.
bugs.fix: Re-read the exact manifest strings and applied a corrected focused patch.

bugs.error_message: MINT problem formulation shows no matching datasets for the MODFLOW 6 simulation archive input.
bugs.root_cause: The archive resource creation path does not set resource-level mint_standard_variables, and simulation-archive has no generic SVO binding; the adapter skips resources without mapped resource annotations.
bugs.fix: Archive requiredness was fixed separately; evidence-backed archive SVO annotations remain planned for CKAN reconciliation.

bugs.error_message: The local runtime smoke test could not validate any MODFLOW app because the host selected an incompatible Intel-only /usr/local/bin/python3 on Apple Silicon.
bugs.root_cause: The test inherited the host PATH, while the runner correctly invokes the python3 available in the container image.
bugs.fix: The local harness now uses a container-like PATH containing the system Python and documents that the test covers staging rather than host binary selection.
